name: dc_capacity_mwp
rationale: Aggregated commercial rooftop portfolio; not an announced Sembcorp asset.

name: site_count
rationale: Illustrative 60 equally sized sites; no actual rooftops identified.

name: dc_ac_ratio
rationale: Assumed 100 MWac aggregate. Licensing still needs site/unit AC capacity review.

name: financial_close
rationale: Future hypothetical close after the frozen information cutoff.

name: construction_months
rationale: January 2027 through June 2028; no pre-COD revenue in the baseline.

name: base_COD
rationale: All sites complete together; early commissioning revenue excluded.

name: operating_life_years
rationale: Operation through 30 June 2053; no terminal sale proceeds.

name: PPA_years
rationale: Runs from actual COD, subject to the fixed construction longstop.

name: site_rights_end
rationale: Fixed roof rights expiry; no automatic extension under delay.

name: specific_yield
rationale: Electrical yield after ordinary conversion/shading losses, before separately applied availability and curtailment. Not certified P50/P90.

name: availability
rationale: Applied once, separately from conversion losses; engineering assumption.

name: curtailment
rationale: Additional external lost production; no deemed-generation payment.

name: annual_degradation
rationale: Compound annual reduction after operating year one; not a manufacturer warranty.

name: seasonality
rationale: Allocate by calendar days; seasonal resource variation omitted and disclosed.

name: contracted_generation_share
rationale: Assumed as-generated contracted share; no firm-volume replacement obligation.

name: PPA_price
rationale: Hypothetical negotiated green-power tariff including attributes; no separate REC revenue and no actual Sembcorp tariff.

name: PPA_escalation
rationale: Fixed nominal tariff for 20 years, not wholesale-indexed.

name: merchant_reference
rationale: The historical reference is verified, but holding it constant into the future is an assumption.

name: merchant_capture_factor
rationale: Assumed haircut for generation profile/capture/basis; no hourly study.

name: merchant_price_escalation
rationale: Flat nominal reference, not a forward-market curve.

name: post_PPA_merchant_share
rationale: After expiry all production becomes merchant; do not extend PPA pricing.

name: receivable_days
rationale: Assumed settlement receivables; counterparty default needs a later separate stress.

name: payable_days
rationale: Applies to recurring eligible opex only, not capex, tax or financing.

name: EPC_cost_per_kwp
rationale: Within EMA indicative guidance; not a vendor quote. Assumed installation and interconnection included.

name: contingency_fraction
rationale: Planning contingency only; sufficiency not demonstrated.

name: development_cost
rationale: Assumed owner engineering, legal, permit and development budget.

name: construction_draw_profile
rationale: Six construction-quarter shares, each split evenly across three months; development paid at close.

name: upfront_fee
rationale: Illustrative facility fee; not DBS pricing.

name: IDC_budget
rationale: Funding envelope only. Actual construction interest and commitment fees must be calculated in Phase 4.

name: initial_liquidity_budget
rationale: Operating liquidity envelope; actual working-capital need must be tested.

name: DSRA_budget
rationale: Planning reserve envelope. Actual DSRA target is the next two quarters of debt service.

name: annual_OM_per_kwp
rationale: Unverified industrial O&M assumption, approximately 1.09% of EPC annually. Residential guidance is not directly transferable.

name: roof_lease_per_kwp
rationale: Assumed cash roof access payment; no actual property agreement.

name: insurance_fraction_EPC
rationale: Assumed annual premium as a fraction of original EPC; no insurance quote.

name: annual_admin
rationale: Hypothetical SPV administration and asset-management cost.

name: annual_escalation
rationale: Applied to recurring costs from the first full operating year.

name: merchant_settlement_fee
rationale: Assumed retailer/market fee only on merchant MWh, in addition to the capture haircut.

name: replacement_cost_fraction
rationale: Assumed inverter/replacement capex, indexed to operating year 12; deduct in CFADS.

name: replacement_operating_year
rationale: Replacement at end of operating year 12; replacement asset has its own book/tax schedule.

name: decommissioning_cost
rationale: Escalated end-of-life outflow; no salvage value.

name: model_tax_rate
rationale: Verified current headline rate adopted as a constant future modelling assumption; future tax law unknown.

name: tax_allowance_years
rationale: Assume original EPC and replacement equipment qualify for the general three-year write-off option. Eligibility not established.

name: book_depreciation_years
rationale: Book depreciation separate from capital allowances; replacement book life is the remaining operating life.

name: tax_payment_lag_quarters
rationale: Illustrative quarterly accrual and one-quarter cash lag; not the statutory payment calendar.

name: tax_loss_carryforward
rationale: Assume continuity and eligibility conditions met. No group relief, rebates or cash refunds for losses.

name: GST_model_rate
rationale: Current rate held constant; recoverable GST excluded from permanent project cost.

name: GST_recovery_months
rationale: Assumed full recovery within three months; tax eligibility and actual refund timing not verified.

name: sponsor_GST_bridge_cap
rationale: Separate capped subordinated sponsor bridge. It is not an unlimited funding plug.

name: loan_commitment
rationale: User-defined hypothetical request, subject to future debt-capacity testing.

name: post_COD_tenor
rationale: Base 60 quarterly equal-principal repayments; fixed maturity precedes PPA expiry by five years.

name: first_repayment
rationale: First quarter-end after base COD; delays reduce available repayment dates.

name: fixed_maturity
rationale: Final maturity remains fixed under construction delay; no automatic extension.

name: benchmark_assumed
rationale: Illustrative flat compounded-SORA-equivalent path, not an observed spot or forward quote.

name: margin
rationale: Illustrative 225 bp margin; not an actual DBS term or approval.

name: benchmark_floor
rationale: Assumed floor on the floating benchmark.

name: hedged_fraction
rationale: Amortising hedge begins at actual COD and ends at fixed maturity; remaining debt floats.

name: swap_fixed_benchmark
rationale: Hypothetical swap strike, not a quote; lending margin is added separately.

name: commitment_fee
rationale: Assumed fee on undrawn senior commitment during availability; included in the IDC envelope.

name: interest_daycount
rationale: Documented simplification using actual calendar days.

name: equity_funding_order
rationale: Permanent equity funds uses before senior drawings; GST bridge remains separately tracked.

name: senior_draw_end
rationale: Fixed six-month longstop after base COD; no further undrawn senior funding without a waiver.

name: overrun_support_cap
rationale: Separate capped hypothetical completion/overrun commitment, not a real Sembcorp promise.

name: minimum_DSCR
rationale: Illustrative covenant threshold, not DBS policy or a demonstrated feasible level.

name: distribution_DSCR
rationale: Historical and forward minimum quarterly DSCR tests; use available history during the first year.

name: maximum_debt_to_cost
rationale: Commitment divided by defined permanent funded cost; not LTV or proof of bankability.

name: DSRA_quarters
rationale: Target uses scheduled principal and net cash interest, excluding discretionary sweeps.

name: equity_cure_cap
rationale: Separate limited cash-cure capacity. Injections never increase CFADS or historical DSCR.

name: cure_period_days
rationale: Illustrative remedial period; subject to hypothetical legal documentation.

name: operating_guarantee
rationale: No full parent guarantee after completion. Only specified limited support is assumed.

name: largest_offtaker_share
rationale: Illustrative concentration constraint, not an identified or reviewed customer portfolio.
